description: This header file declares functions and structures related to the 'upload pack' operation in a version control system, possibly Git. It includes function prototypes for handling upload pack requests, advertisements, and version 2 upload pack processing.

methods.name: upload_pack
methods.description: Handles the upload pack process with parameters to specify whether to advertise refs, perform stateless RPC, and timeout duration.

methods.name: upload_pack_v2
methods.description: Handles version 2 upload pack process, taking a repository and a request packet reader.

methods.name: upload_pack_advertise
methods.description: Prepares and sends the upload advertisement over the repository connection using a string buffer.
